asr.full_text: Hello traders, welcome to Crypto Alina channel and in today's video I will uncover you a scalping strategy that is so easy to use and to understand and offers insane results. This trading strategy combines a number of uncommon indicators in a way that has been specifically designed to increase your profits, so if you want to know more about this strategy make sure to finish this video. But before we start, don't forget to subscribe on my free telegram group where I share all my crypto trades for free, and also guys, right now, you can claim your personal $3,000 bonus on Bybit. All you need to do is make registration and make your first deposit on Bybit. And after that, you can get your $3,000 bonus. All the necessary links will be in the description and in the first pinned comment. So let's get started! This trading strategy is highly recommended to be used in a 5-minute timeframe. In this strategy, we will use three indicators. The first one is the Parabolic SAR indicator and it will be the main indicator. The second indicator will be the Exponential Moving Average or EMA, and we will use it to determine the trend direction. The last one will be the Squeeze Momentum indicator which we will use to confirm the signals. Well, let me walk you through the set up. Let's start with a blank chart. Make sure you're already in the 5-minute time frame. After that, we will now add the indicators. Click the indicator search, Tape type in the SR indicator click. This one created by Trading View. Let's explore this indicator but first go to the settings of this indicator and head over the style section change the thickness to make it more visible we can see in the chart that blue dots have appeared above and below the candlestick. These dots are trading signals. It said that if the blue dot starts to appear below the price, you should place a long position. Then if the blue dots start to appear above the price, you will close your long position and open a short position. And the loop continues. But you can see from the chart that it shows a lot of inaccuracies. According to the members of TradingView, the strategy offers around 40 win rates. And if you've been trading for a long time, this win rate is not profitable and acceptable, so how to trade correctly using the Parabolic SAR Indicator. By the way, if you are wondering which exchange I trade Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies on, you can press the link below this video and take a look at Bybit. On this platform, you can easily make a deposit from your bank account and trade over 150 cryptocurrencies! You can use leverage up to 100 times while trading to make profits even faster. In addition addition you can use a four price layout to keep an eye multiple cryptocurrencies at the same time. If you also want to trade on this exchange, visit Bybit through the link below this video. Through the link you will get a deposit bonus up to $453. All right, let me continue let's start with this example we can see here that the first blue dot has formed below the scandal but we will not enter just yet we need to confirm that this is a good trade and not just a fake out for that i will introduce the horizontal line you need to place a horizontal line and the reference for that is the last blue dot that appeared above the candle this horizontal line must be broken in order to confirm the upward direction of the price in this scenario you will enter at this candle close where we can see clearly that it broke out and close above the horizontal line and as we can see it really is going upwards the opposite approach can be made when taking a short position look at this example we can see that the first blue dot appears above this candle at the same time this candle broke down below the horizontal line. For this scenario, we will immediately enter the candle and as we can see, the price really heads downwards. But despite having these changes, we will still get caught by the fake odds. To eliminate this risk, we will need to add another indicator to filter out these fake odds, click the indicator search tab type email, click this one under technical, go to the settings. From the Input section change the length from 9 to 100, the from the Style section change the color to white and the thickness to 2, to make it more visible. Now we have a moving average that will determine the current mark trend if you see that the price is above the ema we will only take long positions vice versa if the price is seen below the ama we will only take short positions now for the last indicator we need to add the squeeze momentum indicator go to the indicator search tab and type in squeezy click this one created by lazy bear entry conditions now that the indicators have been applied in the chart let's take a look at when to enter into position for a long position the following conditions will need to be met, first, we'll need to make sure that the price is above the MA line. This indicates that we are in the uptrend. Second, the parabolic sight indicator will need to print blue dots under the candle. Lastly, we'll need to check the squeezes momentum indicator, it must be in green color, or at least the red histogram is decreasing in size. To enter into a short position, or at least the red histogram is decreasing in size. To enter into a short position, we will have the opposite conditions. First, we will need to make sure that the price is below the EMA. This indicates that we are currently in a downtrend market. Second, we will need the parabolic saw to print blue dots above the candle. Lastly, the squeeze momentum indicator is in red color, XR to print blue dots above the candle, lastly the Squeeze Momentum Indicator isn't red color or at least the green histogram is decreasing in size. Entry and Exit Signal. Once all of the conditions have been met, we can now put a LAWN position – put your entry at the candle close of the breakout candle, place the Stop-Loss at the low of the candle, where you base your horizontal line for take profit so we will be targeting 1.25 times the risk for taking a short position put your entry on the close of the breakout candle place the stop loss at the high of the candle where you base your horizontal line for the take profit we'll be targeting a 1.25 times risk backtesting i back tested the strategy a hundred times now here are the results look at this chart i've tried the strategy on bitcoin using a five minute time frame the total trade range reached 14 days with 64% win rate if you have one thousand dollars as capital in your portfolio and use fifty dollars per trade with twenty times leverage you will end up having a thirty three point sixty-four percent increase on your portfolio size which will to total to Total to $133.64 in final account size. Now, that's the end of the strategy. I hope you learned some new information from the video If you like this video please hit the subscribe button so you don't miss more videos like this As always, thank you for watching & see you next time ! Bye.
